title: Add custodian provenance index and region-pin assertor for KMS-backed RBAC v2
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Adds a provenance index for policy decisions and a region-pin assertor that prevents KMS keys from being used outside allowed geozones. Backwards compatible; rollout under feature flag.
description: Context: For customer audits and regulatory evidence we need deterministic provenance for RBAC v2 decisions and stronger enforcement that prevents CMKs from being used outside their declared geozone. This PR adds two pieces: (1) a lightweight Policy Provenance Index (PPI) that records the canonical fingerprint of a policy decision, inputs (claims, operator), and the KMS key identifier used to encrypt the envelope; and (2) a Region-Pin Assertor that enforces a mapping between tenant/residency claims and KMS key zone attributes. Motivation: current audit logs are verbose but lack reliable deduplication and a canonical decision identifier; KMS consumption has occasional misrouted keys for tenants with strict data residency requirements. Solution summary: - Introduce a PPI service that runs as an in-process index (persisted to consistency-store) and exposes a hashed decision id (ppi_id) that is emitted in audit envelopes and API responses. - Wire ppi_id generation into the authorization flow so every RBAC v2 decision includes the provenance id. - Add a RegionPinAssertor middleware in the kms allocator that validates key.zone against tenant.residency_claim and rejects or routes to fallback KMSSafe pools. - Add a feature flag (feature.provenance_index.enabled) and staged canary config (10% of traffic) for rollout. - Add tooling to backfill provenance ids for recent audit windows and a reconciliation job to reconcile index vs audit ledger. Checklist: - [x] Design doc: Linear ENG-8421, link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-8421/policy-provenance-index - [x] Unit tests for ppi hashing and deterministic serialization - [x] Integration test covering RBAC decision -> audit envelope -> kpi emission - [x] E2E gating with region-pin enabled in staging - [x] Feature-flag guarded rollout + migration tool - [x] Add console metrics: ppi_emit_rate, region_pin_rejections Open items: - Reconciliation job tuning parameters need ops sign-off (added TODO in ops playbook). - UX for showing ppi_id in Console is an upcoming follow-up (PM-163). Notable implementation details: - Provenance id is SHA256 over canonicalized tuple: (policy_fingerprint, sorted_claims, operator_id, timestamp_truncated_to_minute). This balances uniqueness vs noise and avoids per-request non-determinism. - Persisted index uses existing tenancy-sharded store (no new infra). We added TTL 90d with manual retention policy controlled via config. - Region pin uses service-level mapping config with static geozone -> allowed kms pools, and a soft-fail mode that logs and emits an audit alert instead of rejecting. Usage example snippet (emitted audit envelope): {"timestamp":"2026-02-18T15:12:34Z","actor":"operator:svc-claims-338","ppi_id":"ppi:3f2a9b...","decision":"ALLOW","kms_key":"cmk:aws:us-west-2:...","tenant_residency":"EU"} Migration notes: - Backfill tool scans last 7d of audit envelopes and creates PPI entries when missing (idempotent). - A reconciliation report will surface mismatches to SRE for manual review. Rollout plan: - Canary 10% for 48h, monitor ppi_emit_rate and region_pin_rejections - Increase to 50% for 24h, then 100% if metrics stable - Post-rollout, run reconciliation and enable retention policy Default behavior is opt-in; customers with strict residency will have region-pin forced via tenant flag. See docs in docs/security/provenance.md for operator instructions.
